resources.string:
Compatibility updates for Android 15 & 16
 Changed the logic of styles
 Changed colors of context action modes
 Changed swipe behavior, removed inertia
 Added ‘Swipe width’ option
 Added ‘App font’ option
 Added ‘Show search bar’ option
 Option to customize recording filename pattern with datetime placeholders
 Updated tab icon
 Playback is now paused when external audio devices are disconnected
 Fixed bugs, improved stability
